title: A birthday surprise
instructions: Omar eşinin doğum günü için hazırladığı sürprizi anlatıyor. Ne yaptığına ve sonucuna dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last month was my wife's fortieth birthday.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I wanted to surprise her, so I booked a weekend in Paris without telling her.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On Friday evening, I told her to pack a bag, but I didn't say where we were going.

script.speaker: s
script.text: When we arrived at the airport and she saw the tickets, she was so happy.

script.speaker: s
script.text: It was the best weekend we've had for years.
